new_fact: The working mechanical judgment API required ordered contract/program links but had no required contract authorship field. Thus its schema alone did not distinguish an agent-generated task definition from a supplied reference or verifier reconstruction.

change.boundary: The function validates declared provenance, not actual authorship. Callers still need raw artifact and actor binding. Human assessment of an agent-written contract is allowed; a human-written contract substituted for agent output is not.
change.no_migration_default: Old callers without a source field fail closed; never auto-label old records as agent-generated.
change.no_retroactive_result_change: No frozen source, raw response, semantic label or prior research score was edited. Latest eight-trajectory native batch already reports C_type_drift_assessed=false. No assertion that an old published score was wrong.

primary_sources.title: Developing and Benchmarking Verification Algorithms to Improve Text-to-SQL Generation
primary_sources.facts: Verification uses the original request, candidate SQL and schema without gold SQL. Discusses fresh-context direct critique, reverse translation and generated-data consistency checks.
primary_sources.own_inference: Use these as strong baselines. A verifier-created explanation can assess SQL alignment, but cannot supply the evaluated agent's earlier interpretation for our C-type outcome. Pure cache answers need an auditable derivation/program representation before a SQL-only verifier applies; absence of SQL is a coverage limitation, not proof of novelty.
primary_sources.artifact_status: Author-linked landing page accessible, shows CC BY 4.0 and a 19.16 MB download. Direct posted download returned HTTP 403. Did not bypass, download via another route, or claim reproduction.

primary_sources.title: Validating LLM-Generated SQL Queries through Metamorphic Prompting
primary_sources.status: Proceedings of ACM Software Engineering 3, FSE019, 2026
primary_sources.scope_read: Abstract, introduction, method overview and artifact statement
primary_sources.facts: Rewrites prompts under expected output relations and compares executions; combines multiple relation checks. This is already an intent-violation detection baseline, not a new name for our proposed intervention.
primary_sources.code_scope: README, run_mrsqlgen.py, evaluation_manager.py, bug_detector.py and workflow links; mutable main, not a pinned implementation
primary_sources.code_observation: BugDetector includes every checker return in the effective count, but only boolean True contributes a satisfied relation. Caller conditions, empty-list reachability and checker return domains were not verified; do not claim an upstream defect from this alone.
primary_sources.access_limit: MR_checker directory link was denied by robots policy; retrieval link did not return usable source. No bypass attempted.
primary_sources.reproduction_status: No install, model calls or code execution. License and full source revision not pinned. Public visibility alone is not permission to vendor code.

baseline_adaptation_requirements: Original natural-language request and schema must reach the verifier; do not verify only an agent's possibly changed contract.
Do not count verifier explanations as the generator's pre-action interpretation.
Track reference/gold data separately from inference inputs; neither our method nor a baseline gets privileged gold contracts.
Specify cache derivation coverage and ambiguous/missing verifier outputs; do not label an unsupported route automatically wrong or correct.
Record all verification, transformation, execution, rejection and recomputation costs; coverage and false acceptance/rejection are separate from final correctness.
Pin and inspect accessible author artifacts before claiming a reproduction; an independently implemented adaptation must be labelled as such.
decision: Keep existing evidence boundaries; finish task review before another paid experimental plan. No method increment or C-type effect established by these engineering tests or literature readings.
